digest.component_or_area: external integration tests / Jira Cloud S3 rehearsal
propositions: A new read-only S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project integration test suite must be added under tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/ to exercise the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume across projects REB and DIG.

The test suite must enforce read-only semantics structurally via an autouse fixture that monkeypatches all mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, ensuring Jira writes are impossible.

The suite must use only non-mutating read paths (compute_snapshot for inbound fetch and bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode) and verify per-project issue counts are identical before and after test execution.
Each test must use a fresh, isolated S3-backed store with a throwaway git remote (s3://<bucket>/<prefix>) that is deleted in teardown, containing only the mapped projects REB and DIG.
The suite must validate that an unknown mapped project key fails closed (raises) during compute_snapshot rather than silently succeeding.
A dedicated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal CI job must be added to .github/workflows/external-integration.yml and the existing external job must ignore the new directory to prevent double-collection.
